The use of pearls in various forms, such as jewelry, has been a symbol of wealth, sophistication, and status for centuries. data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, and influenced by the Greek association of Koralle with pearls; the pearl is often used as a metaphor for the soul and the concept of the "pearl of great price." The parable of the merchant seeking the pearl of great price (Matthew 25:32) highlights the value of the soul and the importance of seeking it above all else. The spiritual significance of the name Koralle, therefore, serves as a reminder of the worth and value of the soul, inspiring a lifetime of striving for spiritual growth and development.
